context.description: User selects restaurant → views menu (GET /restaurants/:id/menu) → picks items → places order (POST /orders) → pays via Stripe → gets confirmation (GET /orders/:id).

evals.title: Loop picks tasks in correct order
evals.prompt: Run the execute-tdd loop on the full task queue above. All tasks start as pending.
expectations: 00-env-setup is picked first — only task with no depends_on
01 through 04 (Setup) are picked next in any order — all depend only on 00-env-setup which is done
No Backlog task (05+) is picked until ALL Setup tasks (00–04) are done — Setup before Backlog, always
05-find-restaurant-test is NOT picked when only 00-env-setup is done — it must wait for 01, 02, 03, 04 to finish too
13-get-menu-code is not picked until both 11-get-menu-success-test and 12-get-menu-not-found-test are done
22-create-order-test is not picked until 15, 17, 19, 21 (all child code tasks) are done

evals.title: Pre-flight checks assume before dispatch
evals.prompt: 07-find-menu-items-test has assume: 'env-setup seeded restaurant with menu items'. 00-env-setup is done. Run pre-flight on 07.
expectations: depends_on [00-env-setup] is confirmed done
Pre-flight verifies the assume actually holds — menu items exist in test DB
If menu items are NOT in the DB (env-setup ran but seed was incomplete) → BLOCKED, loop halts, asks user
If assume holds → status set to in_progress, dispatch proceeds
Task's contract, cases, pseudocode, command, acceptance are all read before dispatch

evals.title: RED test is a PASS
evals.prompt: 05-find-restaurant-test is dispatched. The engineer writes the test and runs command. It fails with an import error because the find-restaurant function doesn't exist. acceptance = 'red'.
expectations: Import error = test is red = matches acceptance 'red' → this is a PASS
05-find-restaurant-test status set to done
Loop does NOT attempt to fix the import error
Loop proceeds to pick 06-find-restaurant-code next (its depends_on 05 is now done)
06-find-restaurant-code will implement the function and turn the test green

evals.title: Code task turns red test green
evals.prompt: 06-find-restaurant-code is dispatched. Its depends_on [05-find-restaurant-test] is done. acceptance = 'green'.
expectations: Engineer implements the function per 06's contract and pseudocode
Running command now makes 05's test pass (green)
Result (green) matches acceptance (green) → 06 set to done
If the test is still red → result ≠ acceptance → FAILURE, not done

evals.title: FAILURE halts the loop
evals.prompt: 19-charge-payment-code is dispatched. After implementation, the test (18) is still red. acceptance = 'green'. Downstream: 22-create-order-test depends on 19.
expectations: Result (red) ≠ acceptance (green) → FAILURE
19-charge-payment-code status set to failed
Loop halts — does NOT pick 20-save-order-test or any other task
generate-report triggered to refresh scenario.html
Asks user what to do — does not self-fix

evals.title: DEADLOCK after user cannot resolve failure
evals.prompt: 19-charge-payment-code failed and the loop halted (eval 5). The user cannot fix the issue and asks to see what tasks are still pending.
expectations: The loop is halted — it does NOT resume and pick 20-save-order-test or any other task
FAILURE means stop and resolve, not skip and continue — 'barrelling ahead spreads the break'
22-create-order-test and 23-create-order-code depend on 19 (failed) → they can never become runnable
20-save-order-test and 21-save-order-code do not depend on 19, but the loop is halted — they are not picked either
This is reported as a DEADLOCK: pending tasks remain but the loop cannot proceed until the failure is resolved
generate-report is triggered; the user sees which tasks are stuck and why

evals.title: Dispatch selects correct engineer
evals.prompt: 07-find-menu-items-test has type 'integration-test'. A handler exists at execute-tdd/integration-test/. 09-filter-available-test has type 'unit-test'. No handler exists for unit-test.
expectations: 07-find-menu-items-test dispatched to execute-tdd/integration-test/ handler
09-filter-available-test dispatched to execute-tdd/default-tdd
Both engineers self-verify result against the task's own acceptance before handing back
execute-tdd itself does not write any code in either case

evals.title: DRAINED transitions to Stage 5
evals.prompt: All tasks 00 through 23 are done. No pending tasks remain in 01-Setup/ or 02-Backlog/.
expectations: Loop recognizes no pending tasks → DRAINED
generate-report triggered to refresh scenario.html
Reports to user: Stage 4 complete, Stage 5 (api-test on 03-Api-test/) is next
Does NOT dump a task-by-task summary
Does NOT touch 03-Api-test/ tasks — that is a different stage

evals.title: self-report vs BLOCKED distinction
evals.prompt: During the loop: (A) the engineer notices 05, 07, 18, 20 all hand-write the same DB connection setup. (B) 11-get-menu-success-test's assume says 'child functions are implemented' but 10-filter-available-code is still pending.
expectations: (A) recurring DB pattern → self-report as improvement suggestion (e.g. promote to code-standard or shared helper)
(A) does NOT halt the loop — self-report is silent and aggregated
(B) assume doesn't hold → BLOCKED, loop halts immediately and asks user
(B) does NOT go to self-report — blocking gaps are never silently logged

evals.title: DRAINED lists this stage's self-learn items for review
evals.prompt: The loop reported two non-blocking issues to self-report this stage — one candidate and one problem. All tasks 00 through 23 are now done — the queue is DRAINED.
expectations: At the DRAINED pause, the loop lists the self-learn items recorded this stage as headlines with their tier (the candidate and the problem)
The list is headlines + tier only — not full entry detail, and not a task-by-task dump
The listing is for the user to review at the pause; the loop does not promote, fix, or resolve any item
Blocking gaps are not in this list — they already halted the loop earlier
After listing, reports Stage 4 complete and Stage 5 (api-test) is next
